verses.1: For destruction, children of desolation from the time of creation.
verses.2: All the nations shall raise their voices in praise to God with a joyful cry.
verses.3: For Jehovah is a great king over all the earth.
verses.4: Let the nations speak under us, and let the peoples be subject to our feet.
verses.5: May He choose for us our portion from Jacob’s inheritance, that which He loved.
verses.6: God rose up in triumph, Jehovah with a loud shout.
verses.7: Sing to God! Sing for our king! Sing!
verses.8: For the king of all the earth is God. Let him sing praises to Him.
verses.9: The King of God reigns over all nations. God sits upon His holy throne.
verses.10: The generous people were gathered together with the God of Abraham. For there are many gods in the earth, but only one God.
